icons.name: embeddings
icons.heading: Place the token
icons.description: A token appears at the origin and travels out along its vector to sit near an existing point. Strong prepares at the origin, places the token decisively, then settles with bounded spatial follow-through. Existing data never moves.
icons.label: Embeddings
icons.intent: A token appears at the origin and travels out along its vector to sit near an existing point. Strong prepares at the origin, places the token decisively, then settles with bounded spatial follow-through. Existing data never moves.
icons.brief: Light: token fades in at the origin over the opaque axis join (0-.1), then travels to P2 while vector-2 draws behind it (.1-.56). Strong: prepare, accelerate continuously through placement, then settle once at the shared endpoint. Current authored curves define timing. Fixed: axes, vector-1, point-1. Test: Duotone equals Outline; vector caps at O coincide with the axis round join at all weights; vector-2 is gated off until 2% drawn so no zero-length stub; token disc overlaps only opaque paint while translucent; vector-2 tip stays 1.4k inside the token disc for all k; reset fades vector-2 and token together (request common-opacity group).
